description: Create Interactive Route Planning Tool with SavedRoute model, route planner REST endpoints, and Angular component at /route-planner. Features: origin/destination with autocomplete, waypoint management, route visualization on map (Google Maps or Mapbox), distance/duration calculation, alternative routes, save/load saved routes. Check for API key in .env; if missing, implement integration structure and document required env var.
steps: 1. Create SavedRoute model at frontend/server/models/savedRoute.js with schema: { userId: String (indexed), name: String, origin: { name, lat, lng }, destination: { name, lat, lng }, waypoints: [{ name, lat, lng }], distance: Number, duration: Number, createdAt: Date }

2. Create route planner controller at frontend/server/controller/routePlanner.js with methods: getSavedRoutes(userId), saveRoute(userId, routeData), deleteRoute(userId, routeId), calculateRoute(origin, destination, waypoints) that returns mock distance/duration if no map API configured

3. Create route planner routes at frontend/server/routes/routePlanner.js: GET /api/v1/route-planner/saved?userId=X, POST /api/v1/route-planner/saved, DELETE /api/v1/route-planner/saved/:id, POST /api/v1/route-planner/calculate
4. Register route planner routes in frontend/server/index.js: const routePlannerRoutes = require('./routes/routePlanner'); app.use(routePlannerRoutes);

5. Check for MAP_API_KEY in process.env in routePlanner controller. If missing, log warning and use mock calculation: distance = haversine formula, duration = distance / 60 (km/h average). If present, integrate with Google Maps Directions API or Mapbox Directions API

6. Create frontend service at frontend/src/app/service/route-planner.service.ts with methods: getSavedRoutes(userId), saveRoute(routeData), deleteRoute(routeId), calculateRoute(origin, destination, waypoints). Use HttpClient for API calls

7. Create route planner component at frontend/src/app/Component/route-planner/route-planner.component.ts with template showing: origin input with autocomplete, destination input with autocomplete, Add Waypoint button, waypoint list with remove buttons, Calculate Route button, route display area showing distance/duration/alternative routes, Save Route button, saved routes list with load/delete actions

8. For autocomplete without map API: use static list of major Indian cities with lat/lng coordinates hardcoded in component. For autocomplete with map API: use Google Places Autocomplete or Mapbox Geocoding API
9. Add map visualization: if MAP_API_KEY exists, embed Google Maps or Mapbox GL JS with route polyline. If no API key, show text-based route summary with city names and distances
10. Add route to frontend/src/app/app.routes.ts: { path: 'route-planner', component: RoutePlannerComponent, canActivate: [authGuard] }

11. Add route planner link to navbar account dropdown at frontend/src/app/Component/navbar/navbar.component.html: add menu item 'Route Planner' below 'My Trips' using NAV.ROUTE_PLANNER translation key

12. Add translation keys to en.json, hi.json, mr.json: MAP.ORIGIN, MAP.DESTINATION, MAP.ADD_WAYPOINT, MAP.CALCULATE, MAP.SAVE_ROUTE, MAP.DISTANCE, MAP.DURATION, MAP.SAVED_ROUTES, MAP.LOAD, MAP.DELETE, MAP.NO_SAVED_ROUTES, NAV.ROUTE_PLANNER

13. Create frontend/server/README-MAPS.md documenting: MAP_API_KEY env var, instructions for Google Maps API key (enable Directions API and Places API) or Mapbox token, fallback behavior when key is missing (mock calculation, static city list, no map visualization)
acceptance_criteria: SavedRoute model exists with userId, name, origin, destination, waypoints, distance, duration fields
Route planner REST endpoints respond correctly: GET returns user's saved routes, POST saves route, DELETE removes route, POST /calculate returns distance and duration
/route-planner page is accessible after sign-in and protected by authGuard
Origin and destination inputs have autocomplete (static city list if no API key, live geocoding if API key present)
Users can add multiple waypoints and remove them
Calculate button computes route distance and duration (mock formula if no API key, real API call if key present)
Save button stores route with user-provided name
Saved routes list displays and allows loading saved routes into form or deleting them
If MAP_API_KEY exists, map displays route polyline. If missing, text summary shows route
Route planner link appears in navbar account dropdown
All route planner text uses MAP.* translation keys
README-MAPS.md documents required env var and setup instructions
